title: Survodutide MASH+PEN Registration Strategy — China NDA Submission Pathway (TA-CEC@2025.04.17)

background.text: Previous China NDA submission pathway was proposed under uncertainty of PEN package readiness, prioritizing approval timeline of both indications. New request updated the pathway to enable MASH NDA submission with PEN, targeting earliest MASH/PEN approval for NRDL negotiation.
background.quote: The previous China NDA submission pathway was proposed, given the uncertainty of PEN package readiness and prioritizing the approval timeline of the two indications.

background.text: New proposed pathway: CN sub Obesity Dec 2026 → CN appr. Obesity Mar-Jun 2028; CN sub MASH Nov 2027 → CN con. appr. MASH/PEN Nov 2028; CN appr. Obesity+MASH/PEN Mar-Jun 2029. 12M approval timeline for post-approval change set; checkpoint Oct 2028.
background.quote:
12M approval timeline for post-approval change is set: leverage with MASH/Pen NDA application, apply to waive QC testing and  accelerate Obesity/Pen review timeline.
      A check point is set up in Oct 2028 to further evaluate Obesity/PEN post- approval timeline, due to evolvement of China regulation.

background.text: Medium risk of having no brand name but only Trademark for MASH/PEN; commercial assessment: impact is controllable and tolerable compared to losing NRDL negotiation chance in 2029.
background.quote:
** Potential uncertainty to get trade/brand name “A” (Medium risk to have no brand but only Trademark for MASH/PEN.)
Assessment from commercial: Compared to the cost of losing chance of having MASH/PEN for NRDL negotiation in 2029, the impact of having no brand name but only trademark for MASH/PEN is controllable and tolerable.

for_endorsement.text: Updated China NDA submission pathway for Survodutide MASH+PEN registration strategy submitted to TA-CEC for endorsement.
for_endorsement.quote: Based on the new request on MASH/PEN and the latest timeline of PEN package, the China NDA submission pathway is updated.

decision.text: TA-CEC endorsed the updated MASH+PEN China NDA submission pathway at CEC@2025.04.17.
